title: spec liveness/page.json: props.record.* rows say planned while app-shell PageView reads record.sort
body:
domain:server#6 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzibcN9oHa8kDbTTnL5

Filed from PR #30084 (card #30023), contract review PASS at `c745679c`, 2026-11-04. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.

Business reason: `packages/spec/liveness/page.json` grades every `props.record.*` row `planned`. But `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx` (`appPageRecordBinding`) reads the app page `record` binding: at least `record.sort` reaches `$orderby` at line 236 (objectui#12931). A stale `planned` row tells authors and agents that the key does nothing.

Reader who acts: `packages/spec` liveness owner.

## What to do
- Regrade each `props.record.*` row with a reader citation, following the liveness regrade recipe. Leave a row `planned` only where no reader exists.

Dedupe: `liveness page record`, `appPageRecordBinding`. **New.**
